teaching.kind: 由動詞搭配與語境選字
knowledge: 一詞須同時符合搭配與意思
measure body temperature 是量體溫；high fever 與 temperature 形成語境線索。只知道單字詞性相同，還不足以選出答案。
steps: 句中 high fever 說 Amy 懷疑發高燒。
measuring her body 後需填被量測的身體指標。
temperature 為體溫，符合 measure body temperature 搭配。
其餘 existence、image、structure 不支持發燒判斷，故選 D。
reasons: existence 是存在，不是測量發燒的指標。
image 是影像，與本句量體溫情境不合。
structure 是結構，無法直接確認高燒。
temperature 與 measure、fever 同時搭配。

transfer.prompt: The nurse measured his body ____ because he felt feverish. 應填什麼？並指出兩個線索。
transfer.answer: temperature；線索為 measured 與 feverish。
steps: 先抓量測動作。
再看發燒情境。
將 temperature 代入，搭配與語意均成立。

teaching.kind: 畫線字同義改寫與詞性核對
knowledge: 代回句子，而不是挑同主題單字
option 在此是可選的方案，choice 可同義替換。material、quantity、sample 雖可能與買車相關，卻不能在此取代「選項」。
steps: 畫線字是 option，不是 affordable。
used one 指二手車，是為省錢可選的方案。
a more affordable choice 可自然代回，仍為較負擔得起的選擇。
其他字改變意思，故選 A。
reasons: choice 保留可選方案的意思。
material 是材料，不能代替方案。
quantity 是數量，不表購車選擇。
sample 是樣本，與本句 option 不同義。

transfer.prompt: We have two options. 用近義詞改寫並保留意思。
steps: 確認 options 指可選方案。
以名詞複數 choices 替代。
不改變數量 two 與句子的選擇語意。

questions.excerpt: Customer: Hi, do you sell phone chargers? Clerk: Yes, over there. Take a look, please. Customer: Great, I’ll take this one. How much is it? Clerk: That’ll be NT$ 350. ________. Customer: No, just the charger. Clerk: OK, got it.

teaching.kind: 從下句回答倒推問句功能
knowledge: 否定回答的對象必須對應
No, just the charger. 表示沒有其他商品。因此前句應問還要不要別的；若問 Is that all?，自然應答通常是肯定已買齊，而非本題的否定。
steps: 先讀空格後：No, just the charger.。
just 表示只要充電器，No 否定還要其他商品。
Anything else? 正是詢問是否再加購。
付款方式或商品是否好用都無法接上此回答，故選 B。
reasons: Is that all? 問是否就這些，通常應以 Yes, just… 回答才一致。
No 否定加購，just the charger 補充只買原商品。
Cash or credit card 問付款選擇，不接受本句 No 的回答。
是否好用與購買數量無直接對應。

transfer.prompt: 店員問 Anything else?，若只要原商品，可怎麼回答？
transfer.answer: No, that is all. / No, just this one.。
steps: 辨識問句為加購詢問。
No 表示不加購。
補上原商品或 that is all，維持語用一致。

questions.passage: May 18 is International Day for Women in Maritime, which recognizes the importance o f women in the ocean transport industry. The theme for 2025 was “An Ocean of Opportunities for Women.” In Taiwan, women represent only 4% of seafarers (航海人員). 21 ________ the 260 women seafarers, many have proved that seafaring can be a rewarding career. One woman who shows the way is Huang Chao-ling (黃昭玲). Huang, who was a captain, is Taiwan’s first and only female harbor pilot. As a harbor pilot, she guides ships safely in and out of the port, which is a 22 ________ job that requires taking risks, such as climbing onto a moving ship in big waves. Another front-runner is Lin Chia-ling (林嘉玲), Taiwan’s first woman oil tanker captain. Lin’s job is to ensure reliable delivery of oil to all ports in Taiwan, 23 ________ the weather is terrible. Huang and Lin share a hard career path, given that women seafarers face various challenges, including insufficient onboard facilities. Today, the maritime industry is working to create a gender-friendly workplace 24 ________ . Such efforts are seeing results, with the number of Taiwanese women captains standing at 22 in 2024, up from 6 about ten years ago.
questions.subject: english

teaching.kind: 介系詞表示群體中的成員
knowledge: 先讀空格後的名詞群
Among the 260 women seafarers 表「在這 260 位女性船員之中」。among 連群體；during 連時間，near、opposite 主要表位置，不能只因詞性皆為介系詞就視為等價。
steps: 共同文章先說臺灣女性船員數量。
空格後是 the 260 women seafarers，屬於人群。
下句 many have proved 是從這群人中談許多人的成果。
用 Among 表群體之中，選 A；必須讀文章，不是單看「第21格」。
reasons: among 與後面的群體名詞及 many 呼應。
during 應接一段時間，不適合這群人。
near 是附近，無法表現「其中許多人」的集合關係。
opposite 是對面或相反位置，不合篇章語意。

transfer.prompt: ____ the ten designs, three use recycled materials. 填 Among 或 During？
steps: ten designs 是集合，不是時間。
three 指集合中的三個。
Among 表示在這十個設計之中。

teaching.kind: 讓步連接詞與完整子句
knowledge: 「即使」與「為了」的方向不同
ensure reliable delivery even when the weather is terrible，表示即使天候惡劣仍完成運送。so that 引目的或結果；or else 表否則，不能代替讓步關係。
steps: 文章說 Lin 要確保可靠運送，後接 weather is terrible。
惡劣天候是逆境，不是她想達到的目的。
前後構成「即使…仍…」，需 even when 連接完整子句。
選 A；so that 會錯成為了讓天候惡劣。
reasons: even when 正確引出讓步時間情境。
just where 表位置，無法表現本題逆境。
or else 表不然的後果，與後句語意不合。
so that 常引目的／結果，並非此處的讓步。

transfer.prompt: The team keeps working ____ the task is difficult. 填 even when，並翻譯關係。
transfer.answer: even when；即使任務困難，團隊仍持續工作。
steps: 先看前後是否相反於預期。
困難是逆境，持續工作是仍發生的動作。
以 even when 引入讓步子句。

teaching.kind: 不定詞目的與全段主旨一致
knowledge: 句法可行還要目的合理
四個選項均以 to 開頭，不能只靠不定詞形式選。gender-friendly workplace 的目的應是改善女性就業，還須與後文女船長數量上升相呼應。
steps: 定位主句：產業正在創造性別友善職場。
下一句說努力見效，女船長人數增加，提供目的的結果證據。
improve women’s employment 正好連結前後。
增加障礙或挑戰與主旨相反；增加船隻不是此段核心，選 C。
reasons: 增加職涯障礙與性別友善相反。
船隻數量不是本段改善職場的直接目的。
改善女性就業可連結友善職場與人數成長。
提高工作挑戰不符合減少障礙的篇章方向。

transfer.prompt: The school adds ramps to improve access. 不定詞片語表什麼？
steps: 主動作為 adds ramps。
to improve access 說明做此事的目的。
目的須與措施的功能相符，不只看 to 的形式。

questions.excerpt: 第 25 格
questions.groupTitle: 下篇短文共有 4 個空格,為第 25 - 28 題,請依短文文意,選出一個最適合該 空格的答案。
questions.passage: The Tamkang Bridge ( 淡江大橋) has been under construction since 2019 and is ready for use this year. It was built because the Tamsui (淡水) and Bali (八里) areas have grown quickly in recent years, and more people now commute between them. Once it opens, people can save about half an hour when traveling between the two places. Besides making 25 ________ smooth, the bridge will also appeal to visitors with its special architectural style. It was designed by the world-famous architect Zaha Hadid. Being the first bridge in Taiwan 26 ________ through an international design competition, the Tamkang Bridge will become the world’s longest single-tower asymmetric cable-stayed bridge (單塔不對稱斜張橋). Expressing a sense of art and beauty, the bridge’s 200-meter tower rises into the sky, 27 ________ a dancer were lifting both hands in prayer. Moreover, the bridge’s shape goes well with the sunset over the Tamsui River, making the view much more eye-catching. Visitors can appreciate the riverside views here. With shorter travel time between Tamsui and Bali and its unique beauty, the Tamkang Bridge will play an important role in both. 28 ________ . The bridge will definitely bring travel convenience and recreational benefits to the people of northern Taiwan.
questions.subject: english

teaching.kind: 淡江大橋（Tamkang Bridge）建築工程克漏字：交通流量（traffic flow）
knowledge: 前後文因果與並列線索
前兩句指出淡水與八里人口快速成長、通勤人數增加，大橋通車後可省下半小時車程；因此 "Besides making ________ smooth"（除了讓____順暢之外）必指「交通流量（traffic flow）」。
工程與都市規劃雙字搭詞
traffic flow（交通流量／車流）、air quality（空氣品質）、water safety（水質／水域安全）、local culture（在地文化）。
steps: 定位空格 25 前文："more people now commute between them. Once it opens, people can save about half an hour when traveling between the two places."（通勤人數增加，通車後往返可省半小時）。
看空格搭配："Besides making 25 ________ smooth, the bridge will also appeal to visitors..."（除了讓____順暢之外，這座橋也以獨特建築風格吸引遊客）。
能夠因為「興建跨河大橋、縮短通勤時間 30 分鐘」而變得順暢（smooth）的，唯有 (B) traffic flow（交通流量）。
故選 B。
reasons: air quality（空氣品質）不會搭配形容詞 smooth（順暢的）。
traffic flow（交通流量）搭配 make traffic flow smooth（使車流順暢），完美承接前句通勤省時。
water safety（水域安全）與縮短陸路通勤時間無直接關聯。
local culture（在地文化）無法搭配 making ... smooth。

transfer.prompt: 本文中提到淡江大橋是世界最長的 "single-tower asymmetric cable-stayed bridge"，其中 asymmetric 與 cable-stayed 各是什麼意思？
transfer.answer: asymmetric 是「不對稱的」；cable-stayed 是「斜張式的（以鋼索拉撐的）」。
steps: a-（否定字首）+ symmetric（對稱的）= 不對稱的。
cable（鋼索）+ stayed（拉撐固定的）= 斜張橋。
合起來即「單塔不對稱斜張橋」。

teaching.kind: 分詞片語修飾與關係子句簡化：selected through an international design competition
knowledge: 關係子句簡化為過去分詞片語

原句為 "Being the first bridge in Taiwan [which was selected through an international design competition], the Tamkang Bridge..."。當關係代名詞主詞 which 指代「橋（bridge）」，且橋是「被選出（be selected）」時，省略 which was 後保留過去分詞 Vpp（selected）作後位修飾！
steps: 分析句子骨架：句首 "Being the first bridge in Taiwan 26 ________ through an international design competition" 為分詞構句，主句已有完整主詞與動詞 "the Tamkang Bridge will become..."。
因此空格 26 絕不可再填入有限動詞 is selected（排除 C），而是修飾先行詞 "the first bridge in Taiwan" 的後位分詞片語。
判斷主動或被動：「橋（bridge）」是「透過國際設計競圖被評選出來的」，屬於被動關係（which was selected）。
被動關係之關係子句簡化為過去分詞 selected，選 A。
reasons: selected 為過去分詞（由 which was selected 簡化），正確表達橋樑「透過國際競圖被選出」之被動關係。
selecting 為現在分詞表主動，但橋不會自己去挑選競圖。
is selected 為有限動詞，在無連接詞下會造成雙動詞文法錯誤。
to select 表主動目的，語態與語意皆不合。

transfer.prompt: 請將 "The building which was designed by Zaha Hadid won the first prize." 簡化為分詞片語修飾句。
transfer.answer: The building designed by Zaha Hadid won the first prize.
steps: 先行詞 The building 是「被設計（was designed）」。
省略關係代名詞 which 與 be 動詞 was。
保留過去分詞片語 designed by Zaha Hadid 直接修飾名詞。

teaching.kind: 與現在事實相反之假設語氣比喻：as if a dancer were lifting...
knowledge: as if / as though（彷彿、宛如）＋假設語氣
當描寫建築造型「看起來彷彿舞者正在舉起雙手祈禱（實際上橋塔並非真人舞者，與事實相反）」時，連接詞用 as if，且子句動詞使用過去式假設語氣 were + V-ing！
steps: 閱讀空格前後句："the bridge’s 200-meter tower rises into the sky, 27 ________ a dancer were lifting both hands in prayer."（高達 200 公尺的橋塔聳入雲霄，____一位舞者正高舉雙手祈禱）。
觀察空格後子句的特殊動詞型態：主詞是單數 "a dancer"，be 動詞卻用假設語氣的 "were lifting"！
四個連接詞中，唯有 (A) as if（彷彿、好像）會引導「與事實相反的假設語氣（a dancer were lifting...）」來作生動視覺比喻。
故選 A。
reasons: as if（彷彿、宛如）搭配後方假設語氣 were lifting，精準描繪單塔斜張橋如舞者祈禱之建築意象。
in case（萬一、以防）用於預防未來狀況，不接 were lifting 比喻。
in order that（為了…）表目的，後方通常接 can/may/will。
as long as（只要…）表條件，不符合此處建築造型比喻且不接 were 假設。

transfer.prompt: 若中譯英要表達「這座木造圖書館看起來彷彿與森林融為一體」，英文用 as if 該如何造句？
transfer.answer: This wooden library looks as if it were part of the forest.
steps: 主句用 looks（看起來）。
連接詞用 as if（彷彿）。
後方用假設語氣 it were part of the forest。

teaching.kind: 多序列趨勢圖：以圖例、方向及約數檢核敘述
knowledge: about 與 steadily 的要求不同
about 30% 允許在 30% 附近波動；steadily increased 則宣稱持續上升。原圖是 2004–2024 年能源供給占比，包含五種能源；不可把供給占比直接當成發電占比或總供給量。
steps: 先辨認五條線的圖例與縱軸 Percentage，不能只憑黑白線型猜能源。
天然氣虛線整體上升，A 的 decreased 相反；核能線始終低於 10%，B 不合。
煤及煤製品線在約 30% 附近波動，符合 C 的 about 30%。
油及石油產品整體下降，並非 D 的 steadily increased。選 C。
reasons: 天然氣整體上升，選項說下降，方向相反。
核能原圖未超過 10%，與選項的 more than 10% 不符。
煤及煤製品在 30% 附近起伏，符合 about 的概略判斷。
油及石油產品整體降低，不能說持續增加。

transfer.prompt: 原創占比數列為 29%、31%、30%。能說「約占 30%」嗎？能說「逐期持續增加」嗎？
transfer.answer: 可說約 30%；不能說逐期持續增加。
steps: 三個值都在 30% 附近。
由 31% 降至 30%，存在下降區段。
概略水準與逐期方向是不同的判斷。

questions.groupTitle: 閱讀下文,回答第 36-38 題
questions.passage: Recent studies show that teenagers experience more anxiety and mental health issues than those in earlier generations. In his book The Anxious Generation: How the Great Rewiring of Childhood Is Causing an Epidemic of Mental Illness, Professor Jonathan Haidt explains that two major changes in childhood are mainly responsible for their problems. First, these young people lost real -world freedom during childhood. Their parents tended to protect them too much and carefully control their daily activities. They were not encouraged to explore outdoors, take risks, and solve problems independently. As a result, they might have missed many opportunities to develop confidence and independence. According to Professor Haidt, plenty of free, unsupervised outdoor play is important for healthy development. Without outdoor play, children may be less willing to try new things as they grow into teenagers. Another major change is the shift from a play-based childhood t o a phone-based one. Since childhood, these young people have often spent many hours using smartphones and social media for leisure activities. This leads to several problems. For example, they do not get enough sleep because of long hours on screens. Instead of interacting face to face, they often communicate online, making them feel less connected to people in the real world. Also, constant phone messages and addictive apps make it hard for them to stay focused. When they cannot check their phones, they feel anxious.

questions.passage: Taiwan is a global high-tech powerhouse because of its dynamic industries. Of these, the electronics industry is best known for its importance in the digital age. This industry has a competitive strength which was built from years of developing expertise in electronics manufacturing. Electronics manufacturing in Taiwan began around the mid-20th century. Initially, companies produced mainly components according to customers’ designs and requirements, functioning as contract manufacturers for other brands. In the process, they learned to adapt, innovate, and compete. By the 1990s, Taiwan had become a global leader in computer and notebook production. Major manufacturers developed the expert skills and knowledge for product designing and innovation. Today, some of them are able to provide a full range of electronics manufacturing services ( EMS ). These EMS providers serve various industries that include computing, communications, and consumer electronics. Four Taiwanese manufacturers have made it onto the list of the world’s top ten EMS providers. Taiwan’s electronics industry ow es its success to several factors. First, there is a ready pool of professionals to meet industry needs. Secondly, official policies provide the necessary industrial support. Thirdly, a wide network of local suppliers adds to better efficiency and innovation. Last but not least, manufacturers pay special attention to producing high-quality products, rather than competing on price. Currently, the great demand for AI products offers new business opportunities. Manufacturers who ride the wave of change are making more money from AI servers than from iPhones. For the first time, AI-related products have beaten consumer electronics in manufacturing business. In fact, Taiwan made over 80 percent of the world’s AI servers (伺服器) in 2025. Quite clearly, this demonstrates the ability of Taiwan’s electronics industry to move forward with technology.

questions.passage: Taiwan is a global high-tech powerhouse because of its dynamic industries. Of these, the electronics industry is best known for its importance in the digital age. Initially, companies produced mainly components according to customers’ designs and requirements, functioning as contract manufacturers for other brands. In the process, they learned to adapt, innovate, and compete. By the 1990s, Taiwan had become a global leader in computer and notebook production. Major manufacturers developed the expert skills and knowledge for product designing and innovation. Today, some of them are able to provide a full range of electronics manufacturing services ( EMS ). These EMS providers serve various industries that include computing, communications, and consumer electronics. Four Taiwanese manufacturers have made it onto the list of the world’s top ten EMS providers. Taiwan’s electronics industry ow es its success to several factors. First, there is a ready pool of professionals to meet industry needs. Secondly, official policies provide the necessary industrial support. Thirdly, a wide network of local suppliers adds to better efficiency and innovation. Last but not least, manufacturers pay special attention to producing high-quality products, rather than competing on price. Currently, the great demand for AI products offers new business opportunities. Manufacturers who ride the wave of change are making more money from AI servers than from iPhones. For the first time, AI-related products have beaten consumer electronics in manufacturing business. In fact, Taiwan made over 80 percent of the world’s AI servers (伺服器) in 2025. Quite clearly, this demonstrates the ability of Taiwan’s electronics industry to move forward with technology.

teaching.kind: 細節題的數量、時序與同義改寫
knowledge: 每個選項是一個完整命題
核對數量、年代、主詞與行為。文中四家公司進全球前十，不是十家臺灣公司；早期依客戶設計代工，也不是自己替客戶設計產品。
steps: A：原文說 four Taiwanese manufacturers 進全球 top ten，不是十家臺灣 EMS 公司。
B：1990 年代成為電腦與筆電生產領導者，不是當時 AI 市場最大。
C：原文說 AI servers 帶來的收入超過 iPhones，與此選項的比較方向一致。
D：早期 produced according to customers’ designs，不是自行設計；因此選 C。
reasons: 把全球榜單前十誤當臺灣公司數量。
把當時的電腦／筆電生產成就改為 AI 市場。
與 AI servers 相對 smartphones 的文意比較一致。
將依客戶圖樣生產偷換為替客戶設計。

transfer.prompt: 文中寫「Three local firms entered the global top ten.」，是否等於有十家本地公司？
transfer.answer: 否，文中明確說本地公司有三家進榜。
steps: three 修飾 local firms。
top ten 表榜單範圍。
數量修飾不同對象，不能交換。
